Accountable role: Engineering lead with local product owner
Program scope: required

Scope: A working local installation and guided repository story are ready to show before institutional pilot discussions.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Review the exact artifact, local configuration, synthetic seed and install/start/stop/reset receipts; no implicit remote exposure or unguarded deletion is allowed.
2. Complete the normal browser repository journey and repeated restart/interruption qualification with exact historical retrieval and current denial after revocation.
3. Verify the commands/screenshots/guides against that artifact and distinguish local engineering evidence from all still-open institutional acceptance gates.

- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
